| Yeyakatäj jukumaj ri ajtz'aq; nkichäp kisamaj pa waqi' ramaj. | The masons get up early; they start their work at six. |
| Ri nimach'ich' jantape' napon k'a runaj. | The bus always arrives late. |
| Man kinawoyob'ej ta; k'a runaj chik ninb'e. | Don't wait for me; I'm already leaving late. |
| B'enäq Pa Jotöl ri a Kaqche'. | Kaqche' has gone to the States. |
| Xeq'ax yan oxi' juna' töq xb'e el. | Three years have already passed since he left. |
| In samajnäq wawe' oxi' juna'. | I have been working here for three years. |
| Kib'anon chik ri kochoch. | They have already built their house. |
| Man rutz'eton ta ri ral. | He has not seen his child. |
| ¿Jampe rajïl? | How much does it cost? |
| Jotöl rajïl. / Qasan rajïl. | It's expensive. |
| ¿Jampe qak'as awik'in? | How much do we owe you? |
| Xintöj ri nuk'as. | I paid my debt. |
| Taqaja' jub'a' pwäq chwe. | Lend me a little money. |
| Ninmöl ruchi' ri nupwaq. | I'm saving up my money. |
| Xinwelesaj el pwäq pa pwaqb'äl jay. | I took money out at the bank. |
| Xutzolij ri nuk'exb'al chwe. | She gave me my change back. |
| ¿La ütz yesamäj ri atijoxela' pa tijob'äl? | Do your students work well at school? |
| ¿Xinb'anxtaj? ¿Achike ri'? | Xinb'anxtaj? What is that? |

| Man nq'axon ta chik. | It doesn't hurt any more. |
| Majun ojöb' chwe. | I don't have a cough. |

| Nsilïl tew chwij. | Chills are running down my back. |
| Nq'axon nuk'u'x. | My heart aches; I grieve. |
| Xq'axon kik'u'x ri ach'alal. | The family grieved. |
| Nïm ri q'axomal. | The pain |
| Xyawäj ri numama'. | My grandfather fell ill. |

| Majani nik'achoj. | He is not yet well. |
